feed.title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has an off-by-one error in MSL decoder could result in crash
entry.content:
An off by one error in de MSL decoder could result in a crash when a malicous msl file is read.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-5xg3-585r-9jh5
  • https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-40312

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/releases/tag/7.1.2-19
  • https://github.com/dlemstra/Magick.NET/releases/tag/14.12.0
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-5xg3-585r-9jh5

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q8-x86] ImageMagick has a heap-use-after-free via XMP profile could result in a crash when printing the values.
entry.content:
An heap use after free when reading an invalid XMP profile could result in a crash due to an heap use after free when printing the values.
